questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Flashback?

options.text: It is a scene that interrupts the present action to show an earlier event.
It is a scene that jumps ahead to a future event before the story reaches it.
It is a story arranged out of straightforward chronological sequence.
It is the omission of intervening time or action through a cut that compresses the story.

questions.explanation: It is a scene that interrupts the present action to show an earlier event. This is precisely what Flashback means; the alternatives describe Flash-forward, Nonlinear narrative, Ellipsis, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Flashback.
